import pandas as pd
import openpyxl

path = "budget.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} | dims: {ws.dimensions} | max_row: {ws.max_row} | max_col: {ws.max_column}")
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(ws.max_row, 40), max_col=min(ws.max_column, 20)):
        vals = [(c.coordinate, c.value) for c in row if c.value is not None]
        if vals:
            print(vals)

import os
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "budget.xlsx"
print("cwd:", os.getcwd())
print("exists:", os.path.exists(path))
if not os.path.exists(path):
    for name in os.listdir("."):
        print("entry:", name)
    raise SystemExit(1)

wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
print("sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    print(f"--- sheet: {ws.title} dims: {ws.dimensions} max_row={ws.max_row} max_col={ws.max_column}")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        vals = [(c.coordinate, c.value) for c in row if c.value is not None]
        if vals:
            print(vals)

import pandas as pd

sheets = pd.read_excel("budget.xlsx", sheet_name=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print("SHEET:", name)
    print(df.to_string())
    print("---")

import pandas as pd

for name, df in pd.read_excel("budget.xlsx", sheet_name=None, header=None).items():
    shape = df.shape
    first_rows = []
    for i in range(min(3, shape[0])):
        vals = [v for v in df.iloc[i].tolist() if pd.notna(v)]
        first_rows.append(vals)
    print(f"{name} | shape={shape} | preview={first_rows}")

import re
import pandas as pd

key = re.compile(r"amount|expense|cost|price|budget|actual|value", re.I)
total_word = re.compile(r"total|sum", re.I)

for name, df in pd.read_excel("budget.xlsx", sheet_name=None, header=None).items():
    df = df.dropna(how="all").dropna(axis=1, how="all")
    if df.empty:
        continue
    header = df.iloc[0].astype(str).tolist()
    print("SHEET:", name, "rows=", len(df), "cols=", len(header))
    print("HEADER:", header)
    for col in range(len(df.columns)):
        lab = str(df.iloc[0, col]).strip()
        body = df.iloc[1:]
        nums = pd.to_numeric(body.iloc[:, col], errors="coerce")
        if nums.notna().any():
            keep = nums.dropna()
            print("  COL", col, repr(lab), "sum=", round(float(keep.sum()), 2),
                  "n=", len(keep))

import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    sheet = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
root = ET.fromstring(sheet)
for i, row in enumerate(root.iter(NS + "row"), start=1):
    items = []
    for c in row.findall(NS + "c"):
        ref = c.get("r")
        col = re.match(r"[A-Z]+", ref).group()
        t = c.get("t")
        v = c.find(NS + "v")
        if t == "inlineStr":
            node = c.find(NS + "is")
            val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in node.iter(NS + "t")) if node is not None else ""
        elif v is not None and v.text is not None:
            val = v.text
        else:
            continue
        items.append(col + "=" + val)
    print("ROW", i, " | ".join(items))
